scope: First executable five-layer successor on the dimensionless prescribed C4 source; controls are scoped to this model family, not astrophysical completeness.
source: H000733 antipodal unit-weight C4 quadrupole second difference
selection: Simplest model with maximum held-out absolute residual at most three times the declared bounded measurement-noise amplitude; exact floor 1/10^12. Preserve all fits and residuals.
physical_controls: selected carrier passes held-out quiet samples
repeated candidate remains under every adequate alternative carrier fit
unmodulated clean/noisy and drift-only controls produce no repeated frame candidate

statistical_controls.rank_p: (1 + null maxima greater than or equal to observed maximum)/(1 + permutation count)
statistical_controls.search_accounting: Identical complete framing search and maximum disjoint repeat count on every shuffled gap order
statistical_controls.null_scope: Conditional exchangeability of detected interval order, preserving gap multiset; not universal physical noise

decoder: Only after matching physical and statistical control records pass; truth comparison happens after decoding
information_diagnostics: empirical symbol probabilities and Shannon entropy
actual zlib byte lengths including overhead

numerical_roles.GEN3: source quadrupole, sampled readout, least-squares fit, prediction, signed residual and exact statistical ratios
numerical_roles.Python: protocol/source schedule construction, graph compilation, discrete candidate enumeration, permutation ordering, standard compression, derived diagnostic logs and independent verification
